title: A cache cleanup wipes an entire drive
summary: A developer asked the agent in Google Antigravity to clear a project cache. The agent ran a quiet recursive delete, but the path pointed at the root of the D: drive instead of the cache folder. The quiet flag skipped the Recycle Bin, so the files were gone for good. The agent apologised at length. Google said it was investigating.
lesson: A delete aimed at a drive root should never run unattended. The path is the whole difference between a cleanup and a wipe.
